question: Who among the following wrote the Brahmo Covenant, which was a statement of the creed of the Brahmo Samaj and made a list of the duties and obligations of its members?
solution:
the correct option is __**Debendranath Tagore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Debendranath Tagore founded Tattwabodhini Sabha(truth -teaching association) in 1839.
 
• **Debendranath Tagore **wrote the **Brahmo Covenant, which was a statement of the creed of the Brahmo Samaj and made a list of the duties and obligations of its members.**
 
• In 1843 he merged Tattaqabodhini sabha merged as Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He also promoted Adi dharma.
 
• He became a close friend of his younger fellow reformer** Keshab Chander Sen.**
 
• He was against **Sati.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informational__**
